title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
title_zh: Honeycomb: 常规大小场景记忆表示法用于视频世界模型

paragraphs.en: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memories accumulate RGB observations or latent features, increasing storage requirements as generation proceeds. We introduce Honeycomb, a video world model built on HexMemory, our proposed low-rank representation for storing scene features in a fixed-size memory with a total of six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each generated chunk into new plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, we warp the previous planes while preserving their dimensions, then fuse them with the new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latents from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. The writer processes only observations from the new chunk, avoiding per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust revisit consistency while keeping HexMemory feature storage constant throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our project page .
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型需要持久的场景记忆，以在长时程视频生成过程中保持一致性。 现有的空间记忆会累积 RGB 观测或潜在特征，随着生成的进行，存储需求不断增加。 我们提出 Honeycomb，一个基于 HexMemory 构建的视频世界模型。HexMemory 是我们提出的一种低秩表示，用于在一个固定大小的记忆中存储场景特征，该记忆由六个空间和平面时空平面组成。 一个前馈写入器将每个生成的片段映射为新的平面特征。 当空间覆盖范围或时间范围扩展时，我们对先前的平面进行变形同时保持其维度不变，然后通过置信度加权池化和一个可学习的残差修正将其与新特征融合。 一个读取器从 HexMemory 中检索潜在特征，以条件化后续的视频生成。 写入器仅处理来自新片段的观测，从而避免了逐场景优化和对全部历史记录的重复处理。 在 WorldScore 和 RealEstate10K 上的实验表明，该方法在 HexMemory 特征存储于整个生成过程中保持恒定的同时，展现出强大的视频生成质量和稳健的重访一致性。 代码和更多可视化结果可在我们的项目页面获取。

paragraphs.en: Video world models can generate visually compelling clips along camera trajectories ( Huang et al., 2025b ) . However, maintaining scene consistency over long rollouts remains challenging. When the camera returns to a previously observed region, its layout, appearance, and objects should remain consistent with earlier frames. As generation proceeds, these observations fall outside the generator’s limited temporal context, making them difficult to recover from recent frames alone ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Persistent scene memory is therefore important for consistent long-horizon generation ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 视频世界模型能够沿相机轨迹生成视觉上引人入胜的片段（Huang et al., 2025b）。 然而，在长时程生成中保持场景一致性仍然具有挑战性。 当相机回到之前观察过的区域时，该区域的布局、外观和物体应与较早的帧保持一致。 随着生成的进行，这些观察结果超出了生成器有限的时间上下文范围，仅凭最近的帧难以将其恢复（Xiao et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025）。 因此，持久化场景记忆对于一致的长时程生成十分重要（Zhao et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods address this challenge by storing observations in explicit spatial memories and projecting them into future views. Spatia maintains an updatable point cloud of RGB observations, while LSM-World stores diffusion latents associated with 3D points ( Zhao et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . These memories allow the generator to retrieve previously observed content, but their storage grows as new observations accumulate (Figure 2 ). This raises a central question: can a video world model retain scene information without continually expanding its feature memory? Doing so requires incorporating new observations into a fixed-size representation while preserving information needed for revisits.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过将观测存储在显式的空间记忆中并将其投影到未来视角来应对这一挑战。 Spatia 维护一个可更新的 RGB 观测点云，而 LSM-World 则存储与 3D 点相关联的扩散潜变量（Zhao et al., 2026a；Wang et al., 2026a）。 这些记忆使生成器能够检索先前观测到的内容，但其存储量会随着新观测的累积而增长（图 2）。 这引出了一个核心问题：视频世界模型能否在不持续扩展其特征记忆的情况下保留场景信息？ 要做到这一点，需要将新观测融入一个固定大小的表示中，同时保留重访所需的信息。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Honeycomb, a video world model built on our proposed HexMemory. HexMemory represents scene features using a low-rank factorization into three spatial and three spatiotemporal planes ( Cao and Johnson, 2023 ) , whose dimensions remain fixed throughout generation. The planes are initialized from the input frame and updated after each generated chunk. A feed-forward writer maps the new chunk’s latent observations into plane features, which are then fused with the existing memory. This recurrent update processes only the new observations, thus avoiding per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the entire video history. Before generating the next chunk, a memory reader retrieves latents from the planes to condition the video generator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Honeycomb，一个基于我们提出的 HexMemory 构建的视频世界模型。 HexMemory 使用低秩分解将场景特征表示为三个空间平面和三个时空平面（Cao and Johnson, 2023），其维度在整个生成过程中保持固定。 这些平面由输入帧初始化，并在每生成一个块后进行更新。 一个前馈写入器将新块的潜在观测映射为平面特征，随后与现有记忆融合。 这种循环更新只处理新的观测，从而避免了逐场景优化以及对整个视频历史的重复处理。 在生成下一个块之前，记忆读取器从各平面中检索潜在表示，用以条件化视频生成器。

paragraphs.en: HexMemory consolidates multiple observations into shared plane features, while joint writer–reader training encourages these features to retain the latent information needed for accurate reconstruction. As illustrated in Figure 1 , Honeycomb thus better preserves scene layout and appearance when the camera revisits earlier views, while the compared methods exhibit noticeable changes in geometry and texture.
paragraphs.zh: HexMemory 将多个观测整合为共享的平面特征，而写者—读者联合训练促使这些特征保留准确重建所需的潜在信息。 如图 1 所示，当相机重访较早视角时，Honeycomb 因此能更好地保持场景布局与外观，而对比方法在几何和纹理上出现明显变化。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate robust generation quality, novel-view synthesis, and revisit consistency. When evaluated without dynamic object filtering during memory writes, Honeycomb outperforms Spatia and LSM-World on overall WorldScore. For novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K, Honeycomb achieves 18.45 dB PSNR, compared with 15.58 dB for Spatia and 17.46 dB for LSM-World. These results are achieved while keeping feature memory fixed in size. Our ablations show that a compact configuration uses 19.8 MB of feature storage (i.e., 73% less), with only a 0.12 dB decrease in WorldScore closed-loop PSNR relative to the default. Recurrent writing achieves quality comparable to rebuilding memory from all observations while keeping write time constant.
paragraphs.zh: 在 WorldScore 和 RealEstate10K 上的实验表明，本方法具有稳健的生成质量、新视角合成能力和重访一致性。 在记忆写入时不进行动态物体过滤的评测条件下，Honeycomb 在 WorldScore 总分上优于 Spatia 和 LSM-World。 在 RealEstate10K 的新视角合成任务中，Honeycomb 达到 18.45 dB PSNR，而 Spatia 为 15.58 dB，LSM-World 为 17.46 dB。 这些结果是在特征记忆大小保持固定的情况下取得的。 我们的消融实验表明，紧凑配置仅使用 19.8 MB 的特征存储（即减少 73%），而 WorldScore 闭环 PSNR 相对于默认配置仅下降 0.12 dB。 循环写入在保持写入时间恒定的同时，达到了与基于全部观测重建记忆相当的质量。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Honeycomb, a video world model with HexMemory, a fixed-size memory that stores persistent scene features in a low-rank representation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了 Honeycomb，一种采用 HexMemory 的视频世界模型。HexMemory 是一种固定大小的记忆机制，以低秩表示存储持久性场景特征。

paragraphs.en: We develop a feed-forward writer that recurrently incorporates new observations into the memory without per-scene optimization or reprocessing the full history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种前馈式智能体，它以循环方式将新的观测纳入记忆，而无需对每个场景进行优化或重新处理全部历史记录。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate generation quality and revisit consistency on WorldScore and RealEstate10K, visualize the stored memory, and analyze the trade-offs between feature memory size, write cost, and quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 WorldScore 和 RealEstate10K 上评估生成质量并重新检验一致性，可视化存储的记忆，并分析特征记忆大小、写入成本与质量之间的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Camera trajectories provide a controllable mechanism for video generation. Early approaches inject explicit camera poses or motion representations through auxiliary control modules ( Wang et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025a ) . As video generation backbones transition toward large diffusion transformers, recent work has investigated architectural and training strategies for camera conditioning ( Bahmani et al., 2025a ; Bahmani et al., 2025b ) . To improve cross-view consistency, other work has incorporated geometric priors such as epipolar constraints ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) and richer camera representations, including relative positional encodings and geometry-aware tokens ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026c ) . Related approaches ground view synthesis and camera-controlled generation in explicit scene geometry through point-based representations, reconstructed 3D proxies, target-view reprojections, or anchor views ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2025c ; Li et al., 2025b ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . As video world models expand to iterative camera exploration, autoregressive streaming, and video-action modeling ( He et al., 2025b ; Zhao et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zhang and Du, 2026 ) , persistent memory becomes increasingly useful for maintaining scene consistency over long rollouts. This motivates persistent memory mechanisms that store, update, and recover scene information outside the model’s temporal context.
paragraphs.zh: 相机轨迹为视频生成提供了一种可控机制。 早期方法通过辅助控制模块注入显式的相机位姿或运动表示（Wang et al., 2024；He et al., 2025a）。 随着视频生成骨干网络向大型扩散Transformer过渡，近期工作研究了用于相机条件控制的架构与训练策略（Bahmani et al., 2025a；Bahmani et al., 2025b）。 为提升跨视角一致性，其他工作引入了几何先验（如对极约束）（Xu et al., 2024；Zheng et al., 2024）以及更丰富的相机表示，包括相对位置编码和几何感知token（Zhang et al., 2026a；Li et al., 2026；Zhao et al., 2026c）。 相关方法通过基于点的表示、重建的3D代理、目标视角重投影或锚定视角，将视角合成和相机控制的生成建立在显式场景几何之上（Zhou et al., 2023；Yu et al., 2025c；Li et al., 2025b；Ren et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026b）。 随着视频世界模型扩展到迭代式相机探索、自回归流式处理和视频-动作建模（He et al., 2025b；Zhao et al., 2026b；Liu et al., 2026b；Liu et al., 2026a；Zhang and Du, 2026），持久记忆对于在长时序推演中保持场景一致性变得越来越有用。 这促使人们研究在模型时序上下文之外存储、更新和恢复场景信息的持久记忆机制。

sents.zh: 这促使人们研究在模型时序上下文之外存储、更新和恢复场景信息的持久记忆机制。

paragraphs.en: Dedicated benchmarks assess scene recovery across long temporal or viewpoint gaps ( Lian et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2026b ) and whether unobserved processes evolve consistently ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Duan et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . At the model level, causal autoregressive diffusion and history conditioning reuse recent frames or latents across rollout steps ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Song et al., 2025 ) . To extend this context to longer histories, observation- and context-based memories retain, compress, or retrieve past observations ( Yu et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025a ; Oshima et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026a ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ; Yi et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Within this family, long-range history is represented through latent tokens, recurrent states, positional states, or attention-space memories, including motion-aware retrieval for dynamic subjects ( Yu et al., 2025d ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . The storage cost of retaining such histories has motivated fixed-size latent representations, bounded key–value caches, and pose-indexed history banks with limited capacity ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ; Wu et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 专门的基准测试评估跨越长时间或视点间隔的场景恢复（Lian et al., 2025；Ye et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b；Wu et al., 2026b），以及未被观测的过程是否按一致方式演化（Ma et al., 2026；Duan et al., 2026；Lu et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026a）。 在模型层面，因果自回归扩散与历史条件化在展开步骤中复用近期的帧或潜变量（Chen et al., 2024；Song et al., 2025）。 为了将这种上下文扩展到更长的历史，基于观测和上下文的记忆会对过去的观测进行保留、压缩或检索（Yu et al., 2025b；Li et al., 2025a；Oshima et al., 2026；Xiao et al., 2025；Guo et al., 2026；Zhou et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2026a；Xue et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026a；Yi et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2025）。 在这一类方法中，长程历史通过潜变量标记、循环状态、位姿状态或注意力空间记忆来表示，包括面向动态对象的运动感知检索（Yu et al., 2025d；Xu et al., 2026b；Yang et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2026b；Chen et al., 2026b）。 保留此类历史的存储成本催生了固定大小的潜表示、有界的键值缓存以及容量有限的位姿索引历史库（Wei et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026c；Wu et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Complementary to these approaches, spatial memories associate stored scene content with explicit 3D structure. Early scene-expansion systems accumulated geometric representations for interactive exploration ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025a ) , while recent methods update persistent scene memories during autoregressive rollouts ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ; Yu et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Garcin et al., 2026 ) . Spatia ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) and LSM-World ( Wang et al., 2026a ) cache RGB observations and diffusion latents respectively, so their memory footprint grows as observations accumulate. To address this growth, HexMemory stores scene features in a fixed-size low-rank representation, drawing on plane factorizations ( Cao and Johnson, 2023 ; Fridovich-Keil et al., 2023 ) . We integrate this memory into Honeycomb, a video world model designed to preserve scene consistency over rollouts while keeping feature storage constant.
paragraphs.zh: 作为对上述方法的补充，空间记忆将存储的场景内容与显式的三维结构相关联。 早期的场景扩展系统为交互式探索累积了几何表示（Yu et al., 2024；Yu et al., 2025a），而最近的方法在自回归推理过程中更新持久化的场景记忆（Wang et al., 2025；Wu et al., 2025；Zhao et al., 2026a；Yu et al., 2026b；Lee et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026c；Garcin et al., 2026）。 Spatia（Zhao et al., 2026a）与 LSM-World（Wang et al., 2026a）分别缓存 RGB 观测与扩散潜变量，因此其内存占用会随着观测的累积而增长。 为解决这一增长问题，HexMemory 借助平面分解方法（Cao and Johnson, 2023；Fridovich-Keil et al., 2023），将场景特征存储在固定大小的低秩表示中。 我们将该记忆集成到 Honeycomb 中，这是一个视频世界模型，旨在保持推理过程中场景的一致性，同时使特征存储保持恒定。

paragraphs.en: We jointly train the writer, fusion networks (Section 3.4 ), and reader (Section 3.5 ) with a latent reconstruction objective. Each training clip provides latents, estimated depth, and camera poses. We write the input frame followed by two chunks, matching the rollout schedule. After each write, we query the memory from the clip’s camera views and minimize mean squared error between the reconstructed latents and the original tokens associated with the visible points selected by projection. The loss is computed in normalized latent space.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以潜在重建目标联合训练写入器、融合网络（第3.4节）和读取器（第3.5节）。 每个训练片段提供潜变量、估计深度和相机位姿。 我们写入输入帧以及两个块，与滚动生成计划相匹配。 每次写入后，我们从该片段的相机视点查询记忆，并最小化重建潜变量与通过投影选择的可见点所对应的原始标记之间的均方误差。 该损失在归一化的潜空间中计算。

paragraphs.en: Our backbone is Wan2.2 ( Team Wan, 2025 ) with 5B parameters. The ControlNet branch receives 48 reconstructed latent channels and a visibility mask. Its eight blocks connect to every fourth backbone block starting from the first and are initialized from the corresponding backbone blocks. We train on RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) , with camera poses, intrinsics, and depth estimated using ViPE ( Huang et al., 2025a ) configured with Depth Anything 3, and the same depth estimator provides depth for memory write-back at inference. The branch is first trained for 10,000 iterations with the backbone frozen. The branch is then frozen and the backbone is fine-tuned with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) of rank 64 on the attention and feed-forward layers for 5,000 iterations. Both stages use AdamW with learning rates of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and 10 − 4 10^{-4} respectively and a total effective batch size of 64 on H200 GPUs. Each generation chunk contains nine latent frames at 44 × 80 44\times 80 , corresponding to 33 RGB frames at 704 × 1280 704\times 1280 . At inference we use the UniPC scheduler with 40 sampling steps. The memory planes have rank R = 48 R=48 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的骨干网络采用 Wan2.2（ Team Wan, 2025 ），参数量为 5B。 ControlNet 分支接收 48 个重建的潜空间通道和一个可见性掩码。 它的八个模块从第一个模块开始每隔三个连接到骨干网络的一个模块，并以对应的骨干模块进行初始化。 我们在 RealEstate10K（ Zhou et al., 2018 ）上进行训练，相机位姿、内参和深度使用配置了 Depth Anything 3 的 ViPE（ Huang et al., 2025a ）进行估计，推理时由同一个深度估计器提供用于记忆写回的深度。 该分支首先在骨干网络冻结的条件下训练 10,000 次迭代。 随后冻结该分支，并对注意力层和前馈层使用秩为 64 的 LoRA（ Hu et al., 2022 ）微调骨干网络 5,000 次迭代。 两个阶段均使用 AdamW，学习率分别为 10 − 5 10^{-5} 和 10 − 4 10^{-4}，在 H200 GPU 上总有效批大小为 64。 每个生成块包含九个分辨率为 44 × 80 44\times 80 的潜空间帧，对应 33 帧分辨率为 704 × 1280 704\times 1280 的 RGB 帧。 推理时我们使用 UniPC 调度器，采样步数为 40。 记忆平面的秩为 R = 48 R=48 。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Honeycomb on generation quality and memory effectiveness. For generation quality, we evaluate it without dynamic object filtering on WorldScore ( Duan et al., 2025 ) , which contains 3,000 image-to-video samples that evaluate static and dynamic aspects of world generation. We also evaluate on 100 videos from the RealEstate10K test set, conditioning on the first frame and following the ground-truth camera trajectory. We report PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS against the original frames. For memory effectiveness, we follow the closed-loop evaluation setting of Spatia ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . Starting from the input images of 100 WorldScore scenes, we generate videos along camera trajectories that leave and return to the initial viewpoint. We compare the final frame with the input image using the same metrics. We additionally report flow error, the RAFT ( Teed and Deng, 2020 ) optical-flow magnitude in pixels between the input image and the final frame.

paragraphs.en: Next, we compare three ways to write ℋ \mathcal{H} : per-scene direct optimization, which fits the planes by gradient descent as in the original HexPlane method; a replacement writer, which rebuilds the planes from all stored points at each chunk; and our recurrent writer, which processes only the new chunk and fuses its features with the existing memory. As shown in Table 4 , the replacement writer achieves similar quality to ours, but its write cost grows with the rollout as it reprocesses the entire history, whereas ours remains constant at 13 ms. Direct optimization attains slightly higher quality but is roughly 240× slower per write, further highlighting the efficiency of feed-forward writing.

paragraphs.en: Maintaining scene consistency over long video rollouts requires persistent memory that can efficiently incorporate new observations. In this work, we introduce Honeycomb, a video world model with HexMemory. This design keeps feature storage fixed without reprocessing the entire history at each write. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate better generation quality, novel-view synthesis, and revisit consistency. Ablation studies show that recurrent writing maintains quality with constant write cost. These results highlight the potential of recurrent feature memory for efficient and consistent video world modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 在长视频 rollout 中保持场景一致性，需要一种能够高效融入新观测的持久记忆。 在本工作中，我们提出了 Honeycomb，一个带有 HexMemory 的视频世界模型。 该设计使特征存储保持固定，无需在每次写入时重新处理全部历史。 在 WorldScore 和 RealEstate10K 上的实验表明，该方法在生成质量、新视角合成和重访一致性方面表现更优。 消融实验表明，循环写入能在写入成本恒定的情况下维持生成质量。 这些结果凸显了循环特征记忆在实现高效且一致的视频世界建模方面的潜力。

paragraphs.en: The first chunk is conditioned on the input image using the pretrained backbone and the stage-one conditioning branch. From the second chunk onward, we activate the stage-two LoRA adapters and prepare conditioning inputs from generated RGB frames obtained through joint decoding of the accumulated latent sequence. The eight RGB frames immediately before the shared boundary frame are encoded together as a video, producing two preceding latents. The boundary RGB frame is also encoded independently and supplies the first latent of the next target chunk, which remains fixed throughout denoising. These encoding procedures follow the construction of the corresponding training inputs i.e., video encoding for preceding context and single-frame encoding for the anchor. For memory write-back, the writer receives the newly generated chunk latents together with geometry estimated from their corresponding decoded frames.

sents.en: The boundary RGB frame is also encoded independently and supplies the first latent of the next target chunk, which remains fixed throughout denoising.
sents.zh: 边界 RGB 帧也被独立编码，并提供下一个目标分块的第一个潜变量，该潜变量在整个去噪过程中保持固定。

sents.en: These encoding procedures follow the construction of the corresponding training inputs i.e., video encoding for preceding context and single-frame encoding for the anchor.
sents.zh: 这些编码过程遵循相应训练输入的构建方式，即对前序上下文采用视频编码、对锚点帧采用单帧编码。

sents.en: For memory write-back, the writer receives the newly generated chunk latents together with geometry estimated from their corresponding decoded frames.
sents.zh: 对于记忆写回，写入器接收新生成的分块潜变量以及从其对应解码帧估计得到的几何信息。

paragraphs.en: We examine whether early scene content remains recoverable as new observations are written to HexMemory. On a 129-frame sequence, we successively write the initial frame and four ground-truth chunks, then repeatedly reconstruct chunk 1 from each resulting memory state. The input frame, camera trajectory, and prompt remain fixed across reconstructions. We exclude the fixed input frame when computing accuracy, allowing this probe to assess how subsequent writes affect the reconstruction of earlier content.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究当新的观测写入 HexMemory 时，早期场景内容是否仍可恢复。 在一个 129 帧的序列上，我们依次写入初始帧和四个真值分块，然后从每个写入后的记忆状态中反复重建分块 1。 输入帧、相机轨迹和提示在各次重建中保持不变。 在计算准确率时我们排除固定的输入帧，从而使该探测能够评估后续写入如何影响对早期内容的重建。

sents.zh: 我们研究当新的观测写入 HexMemory 时，早期场景内容是否仍可恢复。

sents.en: On a 129-frame sequence, we successively write the initial frame and four ground-truth chunks, then repeatedly reconstruct chunk 1 from each resulting memory state.

paragraphs.en: With memory disabled, chunk 1 reconstruction achieves 12.29 dB PSNR. After chunk 1 enters memory at write 2, this improves to 16.71 dB. Reconstruction PSNR remains 16.67, 16.35, and 16.30 dB after writes 3, 4, and 5, respectively i.e., a total decline of just 0.41 dB over three additional writes, averaging 0.14 dB per write. Even after write 5, reconstruction remains 4.01 dB above the memory-disabled baseline. Thus, in this sequence, earlier content remains recoverable with limited degradation while new observations are incorporated into the same fixed-size feature memory.
paragraphs.zh: 在禁用记忆的情况下，第 1 个分块的重构达到 12.29 dB PSNR。 在第 1 个分块于第 2 次写入进入记忆后，这一数值提升至 16.71 dB。 在第 3、4、5 次写入后，重构 PSNR 分别保持为 16.67、16.35 和 16.30 dB，即在额外三次写入中总共仅下降 0.41 dB，平均每次写入下降 0.14 dB。 即使在第 5 次写入之后，重构效果仍比禁用记忆的基线高出 4.01 dB。 因此，在该序列中，早期内容在有限退化下仍可恢复，同时新的观测被纳入同一固定大小的特征记忆中。

paragraphs.en: Here, we provide further interpretation of HexMemory through visualizations of its spatiotemporal planes, spatial confidence maps, and stored features. The spatiotemporal planes Z ​ T ZT , Y ​ T YT , and X ​ T XT organize memory features along one spatial coordinate and the write-time coordinate τ \tau . In the visualizations, τ \tau increases from bottom to top, and each horizontal slice summarizes the features stored at the corresponding write-time coordinate. The occupied extent indicates the range of observed scene content along that spatial axis.
paragraphs.zh: 在此，我们通过对 HexMemory 的时空平面、空间置信度图以及存储特征的可视化，为其提供进一步的解释。 时空平面 Z T、Y T 和 X T 沿一个空间坐标和写入时间坐标 τ 来组织记忆特征。 在可视化中，τ 自下而上递增，每个水平切片汇总了在相应写入时间坐标处存储的特征。 被占据的范围表示沿该空间轴所观测到的场景内容的范围。

paragraphs.en: In the alley sequence, the Z ​ T ZT plane records the longitudinal extent of observations as the camera advances. Its lower- z z boundary shifts toward larger coordinates over time, consistent with nearby content leaving the forward-facing view. The Y ​ T YT plane records the vertical extent of observations, displayed with height increasing from left to right. Its upper-height boundary generally contracts as the camera approaches the surrounding buildings and their upper portions leave the view. In this sequence, the maximum observed height remains approximately 0.37 0.37 times the remaining observed distance along the alley, reflecting the camera’s viewing geometry. This contraction eases near the end as the courtyard opens into view.
paragraphs.zh: 在小巷序列中，Z T 平面记录了相机前进时观测的纵向范围。 其较低的 z 边界随时间向更大的坐标移动，与附近内容离开前向视野相一致。 Y T 平面记录了观测的垂直范围，显示时高度从左到右递增。 其上部高度边界随着相机接近周围建筑物、其上部离开视野而总体收缩。 在该序列中，观测到的最大高度约为剩余沿小巷观测距离的 0.37 倍，这反映了相机的观察几何。 这种收缩在接近尾声时有所缓解，此时庭院进入视野。

paragraphs.en: Figure 11 visualizes the confidence maps associated with the spatial planes. These maps record the interpolation weights accumulated during memory writes and provide the weights used for fusion. We display them on a logarithmic scale to show where observations contribute to the memory and how this support evolves across updates.
paragraphs.zh: 图11可视化了与空间平面相关联的置信度图。 这些图记录了记忆写入过程中累积的插值权重，并提供用于融合的权重。 我们以对数尺度展示它们，以显示观测在何处对记忆产生贡献，以及这种支持如何随更新而演变。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 complements the feature-magnitude visualization in the main manuscript by displaying the spatial plane features through principal component analysis (PCA). For each plane, we compute a three-component PCA basis from the final memory state and apply the same projection across all displayed updates. Mapping these components to RGB provides a consistent view of feature organization as new observations are incorporated. The visualizations reveal spatially coherent feature patterns, including repeated banded structures and distinct regions that remain recognizable across successive updates as the observed scene coverage expands.
paragraphs.zh: 图12通过主成分分析（PCA）展示空间平面特征，对正文中的特征幅值可视化进行补充。 对于每个平面，我们从最终记忆状态计算一个三分量PCA基，并在所有展示的更新中应用相同的投影。 将这些分量映射到RGB，在纳入新观测时提供了特征组织的统一视图。 这些可视化揭示了空间上连贯的特征模式，包括重复的条带结构和独特的区域，随着观测场景覆盖范围的扩大，它们在 successive 更新中仍保持可辨识。
